job.title: Days Only Shift Engineer
job.description:
Position: Days Only Shift Engineer
Location: Canary Wharf
Salary: £55,000 per annum
Hours: Continental Days-Only Shift Pattern
Contract: Permanent, Full-Time
 
A prestigious FM service provider is seeking an experienced Days Only Shift Engineer to join their on-site engineering team at a corporate facility in Canary Wharf, working for a blue-chip client. This is an excellent opportunity to join a professional engineering environment, offering a competitive salary, a days-only shift pattern, and a competitive pension scheme.
 
What you'll do:
  • Carry out planned preventative maintenance (PPM) and reactive maintenance across electrical and mechanical building services.
  • Fault-find and repair systems including lighting, power distribution, HVAC plant, pumps, motors, and associated building services equipment.
  • Respond to breakdowns and maintenance requests, ensuring faults are diagnosed and resolved efficiently.
  • Complete routine inspections and preventative maintenance to ensure all systems remain safe, compliant, and fully operational.
  • Support minor works, repairs, and general engineering tasks as required.
  • Maintain accurate maintenance records and ensure all work is completed in line with health & safety and compliance requirements.
What you'll bring:
  • City & Guilds / NVQ qualification in an Electrical or Mechanical discipline.
  • Proven experience within commercial building services or facilities maintenance.
  • Strong fault-finding and diagnostic skills across electrical or mechanical systems.
  • Good understanding of commercial building services and maintenance procedures.
  • A proactive, reliable, and professional approach to maintenance.
Why Apply?
  • £55,000 per annum salary
  • Continental days-only shift pattern
  • Prestigious corporate facility in Canary Wharf
  • Opportunity to work with a blue-chip client
  • Competitive pension scheme
  • Stable, long-term role within a professional engineering environment
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Shift Engineer looking for a well-paid, days-only position within a prestigious corporate environment, with a competitive benefits package and the opportunity to develop their engineering career.

job.title: EMEA Engineering (MEP) Lead - London
job.description:
Job Title: EMEA Engineering (MEP) Lead – London
Location: London
Salary: £85,000 per annum + £5,100 car allowance + 10% annual bonus
Hours: Monday to Friday
Employer: Leading Facilities Management Provider

Are you an experienced Engineering or Hard Services Manager looking for a senior leadership opportunity overseeing a large, multi-site portfolio across EMEA?

We are currently recruiting for an EMEA Engineering (MEP) Lead to take responsibility for the delivery of engineering and Hard FM services across approximately 40 sites in 19 countries.

This is a senior, client-facing position offering the opportunity to lead regional engineering operations, manage budgets and service delivery, and drive technical standards, compliance and continuous improvement across an international portfolio.

The Role As the EMEA Engineering Lead, you will oversee the performance of engineering services across a diverse portfolio, working closely with client stakeholders, local facilities teams and service partners. You will lead a small team of direct reports while providing technical and operational guidance to engineering teams across multiple locations.

The role combines strategic leadership with commercial responsibility, requiring a strong understanding of Hard FM, financial management, client relationship management and engineering compliance. International travel will be required approximately once or twice per month.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the delivery of Hard FM and engineering services across a multi-country portfolio
  • Manage engineering budgets, forecasts, procurement and cost-saving initiatives
  • Oversee maintenance strategies, schedules and service delivery standards across sites
  • Lead and support engineering teams, site facilities managers and external service partners
  • Monitor SLAs and KPIs to ensure contractual obligations and service standards are achieved
  • Maintain statutory compliance, health and safety standards, risk management and engineering governance
  • Conduct engineering audits and drive consistent maintenance practices across the portfolio
  • Build strong relationships with senior client stakeholders and regional business partners
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, sustainability and energy performance
  • Support client accreditations, certifications and wider compliance programmes
  • Use performance data and technology to identify improvements and deliver measurable results
  • Support mobilisation activities and the successful integration of new sites into the portfolio

About You

  • Extensive experience delivering technical Facilities Management or Hard Services within a large, complex environment
  • Previous experience in a senior engineering management or regional leadership position
  • Strong technical knowledge of M&E / building services
  • Experience managing multi-site or geographically dispersed engineering operations
  • Proven financial management skills, including budgeting, forecasting and cost control
  • Experience managing directly delivered and outsourced engineering services
  • Strong client-facing skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels
  • Knowledge of statutory compliance, engineering audits and health and safety requirements
  • Strong leadership, communication and organisational skills
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel, with an interest in technology-led improvements
  • Relevant technical qualifications; Authorised Person qualifications would be advantageous
  • Willingness to travel internationally as required

What's On Offer?
  • £85,000 basic salary
  • £5,100 annual car allowance
  • 10% annual bonus
  • Senior regional leadership position with international responsibility
  • Oversight of approximately 40 sites across 19 countries
  • Opportunity to influence engineering standards and operational strategy across a major portfolio
  • Regular collaboration with senior client stakeholders and regional teams
  • Career development within a leading Facilities Management provider

If you're an experienced Engineering or Hard Services Manager ready to take on a senior international role, this is an excellent opportunity to lead a complex portfolio and make a significant impact on engineering performance, client relationships and service delivery.

job.title: Electrical Maintenance Engineer
job.description:
Position: Electrical Maintenance Engineer
Location: Central London
Salary: £48,000 per annum
Hours: Monday - Friday, 8:00am - 5:00pm
Contract: Permanent, Full-Time
 
A prestigious FM service provider is seeking an experienced Electrical Maintenance Engineer to join their on-site engineering team at a modern commercial facility in Central London. This is a fantastic opportunity to work within a professional environment offering excellent training, progression, specialist electrical courses, and a competitive pension scheme.
 
What you'll do:
  • Carry out planned and reactive electrical maintenance across the commercial building.
  • Fault-find and repair electrical systems including lighting, power, emergency lighting, control panels, and associated building services.
  • Complete routine inspections and preventative maintenance to ensure electrical systems remain safe, compliant, and fully operational.
  • Respond to breakdowns and reactive maintenance requests, diagnosing and resolving faults efficiently.
  • Support minor electrical works, remedial repairs, and building services projects where required.
  • Maintain accurate maintenance records and ensure all works are completed in line with health & safety and compliance requirements.
What you'll bring:
  • City & Guilds / NVQ qualification in an Electrical discipline.
  • 18th Edition qualification.
  • Proven experience within commercial building services or facilities maintenance.
  • Strong electrical fault-finding and diagnostic skills.
  • Good understanding of commercial electrical systems and building services.
  • A proactive, reliable, and professional approach to maintenance.
Why Apply?
  • £48,000 per annum salary
  • Monday - Friday, 8:00am - 5:00pm
  • Modern commercial static facility in Central London
  • 25 days annual leave
  • Specialist electrical courses provided
  • Excellent training and progression opportunities
  • Competitive pension scheme
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Electrical Maintenance Engineer looking for a stable static role within a modern commercial environment, with genuine opportunities to develop through specialist electrical training and progress within the business.
